THOMASVILLE, Ga., November 20, 2026 – Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE: FLO) today announced that its board of directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.03 per share, representing the 97th consecutive quarterly dividend paid by the company, which is payable on December 18, 2026, to shareholders of record on December 4, 2026.


“We recognize the importance of the dividend to our shareholders and its role in returning capital over the long term. At the same time, given the current operating environment, we believe the reset is a prudent step that appropriately balances returning capital to shareholders with our priority of strengthening the balance sheet and reducing leverage,” said Ryals McMullian, chairman and chief executive officer. “We remain focused on taking the steps necessary to reinforce our foundation and create long-term value for our shareholders.”


**About Flowers Foods**
Headquartered in Thomasville, Ga., Flowers Foods, Inc. (NYSE: FLO) is one of the largest producers of packaged bakery foods in the United States with 2025 sales of $5.3 billion. Flowers operates bakeries across the country that produce a wide range of bakery products. Among the company’s top brands are Nature’s Own, Dave’s Killer Bread, Canyon Bakehouse, Simple Mills, Wonder, and Tastykake. Learn more at[www.flowersfoods.com](https://www.flowersfoods.com/) .


Investor Contact: Tim Perrott,InvestorRelations@flocorp.com

and (t) the potential impact of climate change on the company, including physical and transition risks, our availability or restriction of resources, higher regulatory and compliance costs, reputational risks, and our availability of capital on attractive terms.
